LIFE-178: Deliveries keep getting sent down blocked roads

After the landslide, field teams have reported several roads as blocked or limited, but
route planning ignores road status: best_route always picks the shortest route and always
sends a truck. Families wait all day for deliveries that never arrive.

Ask:
1. Road access: add can_pass(road_id, vehicle, network=None) -> bool to
   logistics/access.py. It says whether that vehicle ("truck" or "van") may use the road,
   given the road's current status code.
2. Routing: add passable_route(warehouse_id, site, network=None) to logistics/routes.py.
   A route is usable if at least one vehicle (a truck or a van) may use every road on it.
   passable_route returns (route, vehicle) for the shortest usable route, sending a truck
   if a truck may use every road on that route and a van otherwise, or None if no route
   is usable. Leave best_route as it is. Also add rerouted_sites(network=None) ->
   list[str]: the sites, in name order, for which passable_route finds a route that is
   different from the route best_route picks (the vehicle alone changing does not count).
3. Notification: add notify_rerouted(sites, day) to notifications/sms.py. It sends one
   text to each active household that collects at one of those sites and has agreed to
   receive texts, using the approved message for moved deliveries with the household's
   site and the new day. It returns the messages sent.

Done when: no delivery uses a road its vehicle may not use, trucks are sent whenever the
route allows it, and every affected household gets exactly one text.
